title: kate-core: return reloaded text once
summary: replace_from_load returns the new text. reload_cmd uses that string for from_loaded. The rope is not copied to a String twice. Mode rules stay as they are. This packet does not edit modeline.rs. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust. It does not need a window or a review by the owner. Linux CI runs the tests. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Build the new text once inside replace_from_load and return it. reload_cmd does not call to_string on the rope before that call. Pass the returned string to Document::from_loaded. Keep the from_loaded arguments from PKT-0055. Do not copy the rope again for that call. The reload mode tests stay green. Do not edit modeline.rs. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::replace_from_load_returns_the_new_text
regression_tests.asserts: This test does not compile on main because replace_from_load returns unit. Build a real Loaded from a temp file. Call pin_editorconfig on that directory. After the change, Ok holds the loaded text and the buffer equals that text.
